admin.health_failed: The health check could not be loaded. Reload the page and try again.

check.realtime_missing: The Realtime extension is not enabled. Warble only carries Realtime's updates, so enable flarum/realtime first.
check.endpoint_ok: Browsers can reach the polling address on this forum.
check.endpoint_fail: Browsers cannot reach /api/warble/poll on this forum. A firewall, security plugin or host rule may be blocking it, and without it nothing updates live.
check.queue_sync: The queue is set to sync, so updates go out the moment they happen.
check.scheduler_not_needed: Warble does not need the scheduler (cron) with a sync queue.
check.queue_async: The queue driver is {driver}. Realtime puts every update in this queue first, so visitors see it only once the queue is processed. If updates arrive minutes late, this is why.
check.scheduler_never: The scheduler (cron) has never run. If nothing else processes your queue, updates will not be sent.
check.scheduler_stale: The scheduler (cron) last ran {at}. If it processes your queue, updates are waiting until it runs again.
check.scheduler_active: The scheduler (cron) is running; it last ran {at}.
check.polling_seen: A visitor's browser last checked for updates {at}.
check.polling_quiet: No visitor's browser has checked for updates in the last {minutes} minutes. Open the forum in another tab and check again.
check.interval_auto: Visitors' browsers check for updates every {seconds} seconds, chosen automatically. Over the last few minutes polling kept about {load}% of one server process busy ({polls} checks a minute, {ms} ms each). Warble slows down by itself when your host is busy. For instant updates, run Realtime with its own websocket server instead of Warble.
check.interval_waiting: Visitors' browsers check for updates every {seconds} seconds. Warble adjusts this automatically once visitors are browsing, based on how much polling costs your host.
check.updates_quiet: No updates were sent in the last {minutes} minutes. Post a reply in another tab and check again.
check.websocket_leftover: config.php still has a websocket section, probably from the retired hosted Warble service. Warble ignores it. You can remove it.
